<thought>To locate a retrosynthetic template for the carbonyl‑ene cyclization, I will search the template catalog using the correct functional‑group names: the reaction breaks an aliphatic hydroxyl (alcohol) and forms a ketone, and it creates a new C‑C bond. This should return a suitable single‑step template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["ketones"],
  "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
  "limit": 5
}
